description: This file defines the AxisText class within the PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Chart namespace. It extends the Properties class and manages attributes related to axis text in a chart, including font and rotation settings.

classes.name: AxisText
classes.description: Represents the text configuration for an axis in a chart, including font and rotation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new AxisText object, setting default font size.

methods.name: setRotation
methods.description: Sets the rotation angle for the axis text.

methods.name: getRotation
methods.description: Retrieves the current rotation angle of the axis text.

methods.name: getFillColorObject
methods.description: Returns the chart color object associated with the font's fill color.

methods.name: getFont
methods.description: Returns the Font object associated with the axis text.

methods.name: setFont
methods.description: Sets the Font object for the axis text.
